newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hawker says take no action over bid.
newsitem.headline: Hawker says take no action over bid.

text.p: Car components maker Hawker Richardson Ltd said on Monday that its shareholders should take no action until further notice on the A$1.60 a share on market bid from Alan Jackson's investment group Austrim Ltd.

The offer will exist in the market until close of business on August 7, 1997 and shareholders who accept the offer immediately may preclude themselves from receiving any other benefits such as future dividends, Hawker said.
"It is important to note that the offer price of $1.60 per share only equates to a premium of three percent over the company's twelve month high share price of A$1.55," it said.
The bid values the Hawker group at A$58.31 million.
Austrim also announced a A$42 million share placement to fund the takeover.
Hawker shares ended 31 cents or 22.96 percent up at A$1.66, while Austrim shares ended four cents up at A$3.09.
